issues.summary: Frozen eight-corner bounds rotate volumes; raw MC block-index rotation at unchanged origin differs by a one-block strip for q1/q2/q3.
issues.consumerAction: Use DungeonGeometry.blockPlacementOrigin or blockPosition with verified MC rotation mapping. Preserve PlacedRoom.origin metadata. In-world test all rotations before claiming collision safety.

issues.summary: Ports must be actual boundary opening cells; even widths use the documented local transverse interval. Links start/end immediately outside continuous room faces, and reserve side/floor/ceiling shell.
issues.consumerAction: Catalog must not supply guessed internal doorway centers; runtime must not reinterpret Link waypoints as raw template feet or place end caps. Verify doorway and unused-port safety in world tests.
